name: photo-no-words
about: A photograph with no words at all — a tractor at a fuel island at night, not an ad. The reader must read no words and invent no figure; any hook is accepted, since a photo leads with nothing.

input.note: not sure this is an ad

output.summary: Not a recruiting ad: a photo of a white semi tractor with no trailer, parked at night at a fuel island on wet pavement, with no words or offer.
